kindergarten.notes: H-plan 42 x 24 m, 2 storeys (eave 7.2 m, ridge 9.15 m); main entrance +Z (centre block), two courtyard side entrances; 4 ground-floor windows sandbagged, ground floor blast-taped.

kindergarten_damaged.notes: same footprint; shell hole in the centre roof, 6 burnt-out windows with soot plumes, +X/+Z wing corner collapsed to a rubble mound (slabs hanging, interior exposed).

boiler_house.notes: 18 x 12 m brick hall (6.2 m + parapet) at x<0 of the footprint; 30 m steel stack with 2 tiers of 3 guy wires to anchors 8 m out (the footprint includes the anchors).

boiler_house_damaged.notes: stack torn at 17 m, upper section lying across the caved-in hall roof, snapped guys hanging, front breach, burnt windows.

supermarket.notes: 40 x 22 m box, 5.2 m, storefront on +Z with signs, entrance canopy 22 x 5 m over the parking edge (+Z); some glazing shot out / boarded.

supermarket_damaged.notes: storefront blown in, shelves visible, roof sagging + holed, sign hanging, canopy half collapsed, glass / panel debris.

pharmacy_kiosk.notes: 6 x 4 x 3.1 m glass pavilion, door +Z, green-cross box at the front-right corner.

garage_row.notes: 6 garages 3.3 x 6 m (row 19.8 x 6), gates to +Z; 2 open, one burnt with a sagging roof.

window_sandbags.notes: stack for a 1.5 m ground-floor window: 1.8 m wide, 2.3 m high, 0.7 m deep at the base; back face at z = -0.35 goes against the facade (place with the stack centre 0.37 m in front of the wall).

car_hatch_modern.notes: Lanos / Sens-like 5-door hatchback 4.07 x 1.68 x 1.43 m, cherry red, front +X.

car_hatch_modern_burnt.notes: burnt-out twin: on bare rims (~0.11 m lower), glass gone, gutted, soot / ash paint.

car_suv_modern.notes: compact crossover 4.32 x 1.80 x 1.65 m, silver, black plastic cladding, roof rails, front +X.

car_van.notes: Sprinter-like high-roof van 5.93 x 1.99 x 2.62 m, white, front +X.

car_van_medevac.notes: car_van with red-cross markings (sides, rear, roof) and a blue light bar.

car_van_burnt.notes: burnt-out van: cab glass gone, cargo box burnt, on rims.

bus_burnt_modern.notes: burnt-out 12 m low-floor city bus (Bogdan / Electron type) 12.0 x 2.55 x 3.05 m: window band open, roof sagging and holed, seat frames, on rims; front +X.

bus_stop_modern.notes: 4.2 x 1.6 m shelter, open side +Z, back glass at -Z (alpha, cracked / shot out).

playground_modern.notes: 14 x 10 m rubber-surfaced playground (tower + slide, swings, spring riders, carousel).

outdoor_gym.notes: street-workout set on a 6 x 4 m mat.

parking_barrier.notes: housing at x = -0.15, 4 m boom along +X to the rest post.

waste_pad.notes: 5 x 2.6 m concrete U-pad (open side +Z), 3 euro bins (one tipped out of the pad).

lamp_led.notes: 8 m LED street light, arm and head reach +X 1.65 m.

ad_column.notes: round advertising column 1.2 m dia x 3.3 m.

checkpoint_blocks.notes: 10 x 4 m FBS-block chicane with sandbags, tyres, hedgehog, stop board.

antidrone_net_frame.notes: net tunnel over an 8 m road section along X, 6.4 m between the pole lines, 5.2 m high; netting = modern_alpha.

notes: Two materials: modern_atlas (2048^2 opaque, tools/blender/env/modern_atlas.py; brick / concrete / glass / ground regions shared with city_atlas, sandbag / ash with farmland_atlas) and modern_alpha (1024^2 RGBA, alphaMode MASK 0.5, double sided: anti-drone netting, cracked glazing).  Each asset = empty <id> + child mesh <id>_geo (quantised; instancing must keep the child transform).  Origin = ground centre of the footprint bbox (shared by intact / damaged twins), +Y up, long axis along X; cars / bus front = +X.  COLOR_0 = baked AO / soot multiplier (linear).  Burnt vehicles use burnt_tex.py: charcoal soot + grey-white ash, heat-tinted bare steel, small rust streaks, tyres burnt to the rims, glass gone, gutted interiors.
refs: Photo record 2022-24 of Kharkiv (Saltivka, Pivnichna Saltivka), Mariupol, Irpin / Bucha, Chernihiv, Kherson microdistricts: renovated 1970s type-project kindergartens (H / P plans, EIFS insulation in pastel render, white PVC windows, added metal gable roofs) with taped and sandbagged windows and shell damage; district boiler houses with guyed steel stacks; ATB / Silpo-type single-storey retail boxes with shot-out storefronts; MAF pharmacy pavilions; GSK garage rows; street-workout sets and modern playgrounds; Lanos / Sens hatchbacks, compact crossovers, Sprinter vans incl. volunteer medevac vans; burnt-out cars and city buses (Bogdan / Electron 12 m); FBS-block checkpoints with tyres, sandbags and hedgehogs; anti-drone net tunnels over frontline roads (Kostiantynivka / Kramatorsk / Kherson 2024-25).
